title: Cam Jurgens: Being traded while in concussion protocol is wild, but excited to be a Raven

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cam Jurgens: Being traded while in concussion protocol is wild, but excited to be a Raven
sources.description: The Ravens listed Cam Jurgens as a full participant in practice on Wednesday, which suggests that the center will be making his debut for the team when they face the Bengals on Sunday.
